description: Configures AWS Resilience Hub v2 for multi-account resilience management across an AWS Organization. Covers the per-service cross-account permission model, cross-account IAM roles, and centralized assessment from a single account. Applies when the user wants to set up org-wide resilience or assess workloads that span multiple AWS accounts.
